inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: maphunziro a chilengedwe okhudza kutulutsa mpweya wa carbon, mapazi a carbon, malangizo okhwima, zinthu zodabwitsa, ndi nkhani za chilengedwe.

hero.titulo: Chizoloŵezi chilichonse chaching'ono chimachititsa dziko kukhala ndi mavuto ochepa
hero.texto: CARBONO CONSCIENTE SI CHIZINDIKIRO CHOBIRIWIRA KAPENA CHOLINGA CHAKUTALI — NDI CHIWERENGERO CHA ZISANKHO ZOFALA, ZOBWEREZEDWA TSIKU LILILONSE: ZOMWE MUMABZALA, MMENE MUMAYENDERA, POTI MUMAZIMITSA NYALE, KUMENE MUMAPONYERA ZINYALALA.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Kutulutsa mpweya wa carbon ndiko kutulutsa mipweya monga CO₂ mumlengalenga, makamaka chifukwa cha kuyatsa mafuta akale, kudula mitengo, ntchito za makampani, ndiponso mayendedwe a tsiku ndi tsiku.
acordeao.clima_corpo: Mipweya yowotha dziko imapanga chophimba chomwe chimasunga kutentha mumlengalenga. Kutulutsa kuchuluka, zotsatira zimakulirakulirabe — ndipo izi ndi zomwe zimachititsa kutentha kwa dziko ndi kusintha kwa nyengo.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Ndi kuchuluka kwathunthu kwa mipweya yowotha dziko yomwe imapangidwa, mwachindunji kapena mosachindunji, ndi zochita za munthu, kampani, kapena chinthu pa moyo wa tsiku ndi tsiku.
acordeao.neutro_titulo: Kulinganiza Mpweya wa Carbon × Carbono Consciente
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Kulinganiza mpweya wa carbon kumafuna kufanizira kapena kulipirira mpweya wotulutsidwa. Carbono consciente amapereka patsogolo zisankho zomwe zimachepetsa zotsatira pa chilengedwe musanaganizire za kulipirira.

fatos.fato1: Mtengo wamkulu umayamwa pafupifupi makilogalamu 22 a CO₂ pachaka — ndicho chifukwa chake kubzala nkhalango kuchitika kwina ndi njira imodzi yowongoka kwambiri yolipirira mpweya wotulutsidwa.
fatos.fato2: Nyanja zimayamwa pafupifupi gawo limodzi mwa magawo anayi a CO₂ yonse yomwe anthu amatulutsa chaka ndi chaka, zimagwira ntchito ngati chowongolera chachikulu cha nyengo yapadziko lonse.
fatos.fato3: Kugwiritsitsa ntchito papepala tani imodzi kumasunga mitengo pafupifupi 17 ndiponso madzi ndi mphamvu zambiri poyerekeza ndi kupanga pepala latsopano.
fatos.fato4: Mayendedwe akuyankha mlandu pa gawo limodzi mwa magawo anayi a mpweya wa CO₂ padziko lonse wokhudzana ndi mphamvu — kusintha galimoto kukhala njinga kapena mayendedwe a anthu onse paulendo wachifupi kumasiyanitsa kwenikweni.
fatos.fato5: Amazon ndi nyumba ya pafupifupi 10% ya zamoyo zonse zodziwika padziko lapansi, ndiponso imasunga matani mabiliyoni a kaboni m'zomera zake.
fatos.fato6: Mapaneli a dzuwa a m'nyumba angachepetse mapazi a kaboni a banja ndi matani angapo a CO₂ pachaka, kutengera mphamvu zomwe zimagwiritsidwa ntchito m'deralo.
fatos.fato7: Zakudya zokhala ndi nyama yofiira yochepa zingathe kuchepetsa kwambiri mapazi a kaboni a munthu, chifukwa ulimi wa ng'ombe ndi umodzi mwa ntchito zaulimi zotulutsa mpweya wambiri kwambiri.
fatos.fato8: Kusungunuka kwa madzi oundana a nyanja ku Arctic kumachepetsa mphamvu ya dziko lapansi yowonetsera kuwala kwa dzuwa kubwerera kumlengalenga, zimafulumizitsa kutentha — zotsatira izi zimadziwika kuti albedo feedback.
fatos.fato9: Nyali za LED zimagwiritsa ntchito mphamvu zochepa mpaka 80% kuposa nyali zakale ndipo zimakhalitsa nthawi yaitali kwambiri, zimachepetsa mpweya ndi zinyalala zonse ziwiri.
fatos.fato10: Pangano la Paris, losainidwa ndi mayiko pafupifupi 200, lili ndi cholinga choletsa kutentha kwadziko lonse kukhala pansi pa 2°C kuposa magawo omwe analipo nthawi yopanda mafakitale.
fatos.fato11: Pafupifupi gawo limodzi mwa magawo atatu a chakudya chonse chopangidwa padziko lapansi chimawonongedwa — ndipo kuwonongekaku kokha kumatulutsa gawo lalikulu la mpweya wotenthetsa dziko padziko lonse.
fatos.fato12: Ma turbine amakono a mphepo amatha kupanga mphamvu zokwanira kuyatsa nyumba zikwizikwi, popanda kutulutsa CO₂ pamene akugwira ntchito.
fatos.fato13: Nthaka yathanzi imasunga kaboni yambiri kuposa zomera zonse ndi mlengalenga pamodzi — njira zaulimi zobwezeretsanso zimathandiza kusunga kaboniyi m'nthaka.
fatos.fato14: Zisumbu za coral, ngakhale zimakuta pang'ono pa 1% ya pansi pa nyanja, zimathandizira pafupifupi 25% ya zamoyo zonse za m'nyanja zodziwika — ndipo ndi zosavuta kukhudzidwa ndi kutentha kwa madzi.
fatos.fato15: Kuchepetsa kuwononga madzi otentha kunyumba (mwachitsanzo, kusamba mwachidule) kumachepetsanso mpweya, chifukwa kutentha madzi kumagwiritsa ntchito mphamvu.
fatos.fato16: Magalimoto amagetsi, ngakhale tikuganizira zopanga mabatire, amatulutsa CO₂ wochepa pa moyo wawo wonse poyerekeza ndi magalimoto oyaka mafuta, makamaka pamene magetsi amachokera ku magwero oyera.
fatos.fato17: Kukolowera zinyalala zachilengedwe kunyumba kumalepheretsa kuti zitulutse methane pamalo otayira zinyalala — mpweya wotenthetsa dziko womwe ndi wamphamvu kwambiri kuposa CO₂ mu nthawi yaifupi.
fatos.fato18: Madzi oundana a Greenland ndi Antarctica pamodzi akhala akutaya matani mabiliyoni mazana a ayezi pachaka m'zaka zaposachedwa, zimathandizira mwachindunji kukwera kwa nyanja.

globo.fonte_estimativa: Kuyerekezera kwa CO₂ ya mafuta akale pa munthu aliyense (Global Carbon Budget / Our World in Data, chaka choyambira 2024).
globo.aria_interativo: Globu yolumikizana ya kutulutsa mpweya wa carbon. Kokani kuti izungulire, sikulolani kuti ikulire, dinani dziko kuti muone zambiri zake, ndipo dinani kaŵiri kuti muyike globu mu njira yowunikira.
globo.aria_decorativo: Globu yokongoletsera yozungulira, yosonyeza kufikira kwa padziko lonse kwa polojekiti ya Carbono Consciente.
